name: mic
description: Microphone sound sensor with sliding-window averaging, automatic noise floor calibration, and peak detection. Supports background timer for non-blocking reads.

constructor_params.name: peak_threshold
constructor_params.description: Peak detection threshold as fraction of max ADC value

constructor_params.name: use_timer
constructor_params.description: True: background timer updates samples. False: read samples on demand.

properties.name: noise_floor
properties.description: Noise floor from calibration (None if not calibrated)

methods.name: read
methods.description: Average of samples (from cache if timer mode, else fresh samples)

methods.name: peak_detected
methods.description: True if current value exceeds noise floor + threshold

methods.name: calibrate

parameters.name: quiet_environment
parameters.description: If True, blocks for full duration. If False, uses shorter burst.

methods.description: Sample ambient noise to determine noise floor. BLOCKING — pauses timer updates during calibration.

methods.name: reset_calibration
methods.description: Discard calibration data — revert to fixed peak_threshold

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stop background timer and release resources

example:
from machine import Pin
from mic import Microphone
from time import sleep_ms

mic = Microphone(pin=Pin(34))
mic.calibrate(duration=3)
while True:
    print(f'{mic.value:.1f}', 'PEAK!' if mic.peak_detected() else '')
    sleep_ms(100)
esp32_notes: Timer ID conflicts: ESP32 has 4 hardware timers (0-3). Avoid IDs used by other libs.
use_timer=True frees your main loop from sampling, but uses one timer resource
calibrate() pauses timer updates — call only during setup or quiet periods
Sample count and freq interact: sample_count=50 at freq=50 = 1s window
hardware_notes: Most mic modules output 0-3.3V analog — direct ADC connection works
Some modules (e.g., MAX9814) have AGC — disable via GAIN pin for raw signal
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard ADC requires manual averaging + threshold code. Microphone wraps this with calibration + peak detection.
